# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Hardened the remaining conservation coverage gaps in the regression suites. In `crates/tank_core/tests/budget_tracking.rs`, the weekly trim-and-remove budget test now calls the shared `close_budget_gas_exchange()` helper after loading `ProcessParams::default()`, so future non-zero DIC shortcut defaults cannot create a false carbon leak in that closed-system assertion. In `crates/tank_core/tests/conservation_regression.rs` and `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_conservation.rs`, the water-change fixtures now seed a non-zero `source.nitrite_mg_n_per_l`, so the already-present nitrogen import formula and action accounting are exercised end to end instead of only covering the zero-nitrite case.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the reviewed gaps in the weekly trim-export budget test and the conservation water-change fixtures to confirm the exact closure and coverage changes required.
2. [Completed] Patched the trim-export test to reuse the shared gas-exchange closure helper and updated both conservation water-change fixtures to use non-zero source nitrite.
3. [Completed] Ran formatting plus targeted budget and conservation regressions to verify the tightened coverage passes with the updated water-change expectations.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all` completed successfully.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test budget_tracking test_weekly_trim_and_remove_exports_nutrients_over_500_hours -- --nocapture` passed: 1 test passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test conservation_regression -- --nocapture` passed: 6 tests passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_conservation -- --nocapture` passed: 1 test passed, 0 failed; the summary reported all 6 scenarios as PASS.
- The updated e2e summary now exercises non-zero source nitrite in `water_change`, reporting `dN=+21.187500000 mg` and `dC=+97.500000000 mg`, matching the fixture-backed import/export expectations.

## Outstanding Risks

None identified.
